title: Tanzania Weather by Month
excerpt: What is the weather like in Tanzania each month? An overview for safari, Kilimanjaro and Zanzibar.
body:
Tanzania's weather varies by altitude and region. This is a general overview of the northern parks and the coast.

## January–February

Warm and mostly dry. Calving season in the south. Good for Kilimanjaro and Zanzibar.

## March

Warm; long rains may begin.

## April–May

Long rains. Green, quiet. Some camps close.

## June

Dry season begins. Cool mornings.

## July–August

Dry, sunny, cold nights. High season.

## September–October

Dry, warmer, dusty. Excellent wildlife.

## November

Short rains, often afternoon showers.

## December

Rains fade; holiday season.

## Altitude

Ngorongoro and Kilimanjaro are much colder than the plains.

See [Zanzibar weather](/blog/zanzibar-weather-by-month/) and our [best time to visit page](/best-time-to-visit-tanzania/). [Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
